meta.title: HYG Database v4.1 bright-star subset
meta.attribution: Star data: HYG Database v4.1 by David Nash / Astronexus. Derived subset by SolarReach contributors.
meta.selection: HYG id != 0 (exclude Sol), finite coordinates and apparent visual magnitude <= 4.0; magnitude then numeric HYG ID ascending
meta.transformations: raDeg = CSV ra (hours) * 15, rounded to 9 decimal places; decDeg = dec; magnitude = mag; id = HYG:<id>; name = proper, trimmed bf, HR, HIP or HYG ID. No motion propagation.
